span.p:
0 · CURATE
you, in Zotero
Depth over breadth: everything
bearing on one research question.
papers/bibliography.bib
this same .bib is very likely already
your thesis's \\bibliography — which is
why the two stay consistent for free

div.style: color: rgb(30, 27, 75) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HEAVY — preview only
docling · embed · bertopic
SKILL.md names src/retrieval.py alone —
BM25, k=15, then filter by hand
render — and even this is disposable
--format md and --format pdf,
to look at the chapter. The artifact that
matters is the .tex you \\input.
“A rendering failure never blocks
presenting the draft.”

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · DRAFT
RQ-driven narrative
A standalone .tex fragment —
\\citep / \\citet, no preamble,
meant to be \\input by your own
thesis document.
content/drafts/<slug>.tex

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

p.small:
Reads \\citep/\\citet as
readily as Markdown [@key],
so the .tex path is gated
exactly as hard

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

p.small:
“Fix and re-run until OK.
Never present a draft
that hasn't passed.”

div.style: color: rgb(59, 7, 100) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · PUBLISH — the odd one out
❌ src.references — deliberately skipped
the only genre that skips it. Your thesis's own
bibliography owns the reference list; a second
one inside the fragment would collide with it.
render_output --format md | pdf
a preview for you, not the deliverable

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

p.small:
into your own thesis, compiled by your own
LaTeX toolchain against your own .bib

svg.text: Genre C — the LaTeX-native writer: thesis-chapter-writer
